Nora (Marketing): Quick thread  need final format for the webinar. Proposal: 30m rapid talks + 20m rotating labs (2 rotations per attendee). Keeps it actionable.
Jae (Host): Sounds good. Rotations length? 10m each?
Nora (Marketing): 10m rotations, but each attendee gets 2. Rotation choices will map to HubSpot props.
Mina (Growth): Perfect for segmentation. We should gate the benchmark script download behind the CTA.
Yara (Product): Product will own 'latency profiling' station. Toby can do 'batching + quant' station.
Toby (Eng): I'll prepare a 2-min live terminal demo and a 45s fallback gif. Example snippet: `python bench.py --batch=64 --quant=int8`.
Kai (Speaker Ops): All speakers, please send 2 bullets + demo gif by Tue COB. Ill assemble the greenroom notes.
Nora (Marketing): Draft run-of-show (PT):
```
10:00 - Welcome + housekeeping (Jae) - 3m
10:03 - Rapid context: 3 quick takes - 7m
10:10 - Rotation instructions + poll - 2m
10:12 - Rotation A - 10m
10:22 - Rotation B - 10m
10:32 - Regroup + 10m Q&A - 10m
10:42 - CTA + asset links - 8m
```
Mina (Growth): Can we add an in-keynote poll to route people to their first rotation? Use that to tag leads.
InfraBot: rehearsal-env provisioned: rwdw-rotor-175900. Recording enabled.
Jae (Host): I'll shorten the rapid context to 5m if needed to keep the flow tight.
Nora (Marketing): Action items: 1) speakers -> bullets + gif (Kai); 2) Toby -> live + fallback (Toby); 3) Mina -> HubSpot mapping; 4) Kai -> greenroom invites. Rehearsal tech check = 1759078000, full dress = 1759164400. :white_check_mark:
